person:gawen-grandison.appearance: Broad-shouldered, with greying brown hair, a neatly trimmed beard, steady blue-grey eyes, and a stiff leg from an old riding injury.

person:ellyn-grandison.appearance: Chestnut hair, brown-green eyes, and elegant Meadows-inspired gowns of fine wool and embroidered cloth, often complemented by tasteful jewellery.

person:alester-grandison.appearance: Tall and broad-shouldered, with dark brown hair beginning to grey, blue eyes, and a neatly kept beard.

person:lynesse-grandison.appearance: Soft brown hair, hazel eyes, and modest but elegant clothing.

person:steffon-grandison.appearance: Dark brown hair, a trimmed beard, grey-blue eyes, and a sturdy build.

person:maris-grandison.appearance: Light brown hair, kind blue eyes, and practical but well-made clothing.

person:raymont-grandison.appearance: Athletic build, dark brown hair, blue-grey eyes, a broken nose, and an easy smile.

person:alys-musgood.appearance: Brown hair, lively grey-green eyes, and fashionable gowns with tasteful jewellery.

person:arlan-grandison.appearance: Tall for his age, with an athletic build, dark brown hair, and blue-grey eyes.

person:elenei-grandison.appearance: Brown hair, bright hazel eyes, and a lively smile.

person:alyssa-grandison.appearance: Golden-blonde hair, expressive grey-green eyes, freckles, a strong riding build, and a slightly crooked smile.

person:orryn-grandison.appearance: Average height and leanly built, with slightly wavy golden-blonde hair, grey-blue eyes, freckles across his nose and shoulders, a narrow chin, slightly uneven eyebrows, and an easily overlooked presence in a crowded hall.

person:alaric-meadows.appearance: Light brown hair, hazel eyes, and a lean build that rarely seems at rest. He dresses practically rather than lavishly and usually appears occupied with some household matter.

person:jeyne-meadows.appearance: Dark chestnut hair, brown eyes, and a composed expression. She dresses fashionably in well-made Reach gowns and pays careful attention to appearance and etiquette.

person:leonette-meadows.appearance: Chestnut hair, green-brown eyes, and a lively smile. She enjoys colourful gowns, ribbons, and jewellery, and carries herself with growing confidence.

person:matthos-meadows.appearance: Tall for his age, with light brown hair, hazel-green eyes, and the sturdy build of a boy who spends most of his time outdoors.

person:lyman-verrall.appearance: Medium height and sleek, with thinning sandy hair combed carefully across his scalp, warm hazel eyes, a quick smile, and ink on well-cut cuffs.

person:everard-blythe.appearance: Tall and once handsome, now running to fat, with silver hair tied back, broken veins across a long nose, and immaculate if worn doublets.

person:wyman-latham.appearance: Weathered and lean, with grey-brown hair, a close beard, and calloused hands that are very still around animals.

person:maester-perrin.appearance: Thin and stooped, with a long nose, a grey beard trimmed to a point, pale blue eyes, a chain of several metals, and ink-stained fingers.

person:septon-lorimer.appearance: Heavyset and red-faced, with soft hands, wispy white hair, and a heavy crystal pendant.

person:bertram-corliss.appearance: Lean and grizzled, with a scarred cheek, short iron-grey hair, and battered armour kept spotless.

person:tobin-whitlow.appearance: Golden-brown curls, easy laugh lines, a handsome and slightly dishevelled face, and very fine boots.

person:lucan-marwick.appearance: Tall and square-jawed, with cropped dark hair, a stiff posture, and plain armour kept in perfect order.

person:marya-caswell.appearance: Neat and plain, with light brown hair, grey eyes, and good but remade gowns.

person:septa-lenora.appearance: Narrow-faced and straight-backed, with grey hair under a plain veil and a crystal that hangs against her chest.

person:osric-dunmere.appearance: Tall and thin, with fair hair cut straight across the brow, pale eyes, and a seven-pointed star pendant he touches when he disapproves.

person:baldric-haye.appearance: Stocky and dark-haired, with watchful brown eyes and a patched cloak he keeps scrupulously clean.

person:perkin-fenwick.appearance: Short and wiry, with sandy hair that stands up at the crown, freckles, and a gap-toothed grin.

person:piers-fallow.appearance: Stocky, with dark curly hair, quick brown eyes, and clothes finer than the other boys', which draw comment.

person:tolman-haverill.appearance: Thin and nervous, with receding brown hair, quick eyes, and a habit of straightening his sleeves.

person:dunstan-fallow.appearance: Stout and florid, with fine clothes slightly too fine, rings on several fingers, and small bright eyes.

person:aldous-trent.appearance: Soft and balding, with mild eyes and clean hands he looks at often.

person:garlan-footly.appearance: Broad and fair, with sandy hair, a broad face, and slow blue eyes.

person:edric-baratheon.appearance: A broad man with heavy shoulders, greying black hair, a square beard, and dark blue eyes. Age has thickened rather than weakened him.

person:alysanne-baratheon.appearance: Dark chestnut hair streaked with silver, soft brown eyes, and a composed expression.

person:lyonel-baratheon.appearance: Tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome, with thick black hair, bright blue eyes, and an easy smile.

person:laena-baratheon.appearance: Dark auburn hair, pale skin, and thoughtful grey eyes.

person:boremund-baratheon.appearance: Slightly shorter than Lyonel, with broad features, thinning black hair, and thoughtful blue eyes.

person:ellyn-baratheon.appearance: Brown hair, hazel eyes, and an expressive face.

person:edwyn-baratheon.appearance: A skinny boy with untidy black hair and bright blue eyes.

person:gowen-baratheon.appearance: Powerfully built, with unruly black hair, storm-blue eyes, and the permanent look of someone who has just returned from the training yard or the hunt.

person:ormund-baratheon.appearance: Small and sturdy, with thick black hair, bright blue eyes and scraped knees.

person:alysanne-penrose.appearance: A straight-backed woman with silver-streaked auburn hair, pale blue eyes, a narrow face, and an austere bearing. Her gowns are finely made but conservative, and she commonly wears a small piece of Hightower jewellery at her throat.

person:jon-penrose.appearance: Broad-shouldered and handsome, with thick dark-auburn hair, hazel-grey eyes, and an expressive smile. He favours well-cut clothing, polished armour, and small displays of Penrose heraldry.

person:dondarrion-unnamed-lord.appearance: A tall but ageing man with heavy shoulders, weathered features, iron-grey hair, and stern grey eyes. He dresses plainly for a lord of his standing and still wears a sword even at household meals.

person:ravella-dondarrion.appearance: A slender woman with greying brown hair, dark eyes, and an erect bearing. She favours restrained gowns of good wool and wears little jewellery beyond pieces inherited from House Selmy.

person:myrielle-dondarrion.appearance: A long-faced woman with dark brown hair beginning to grey, deep-set brown eyes, and a controlled expression. She dresses in Dondarrion colours but continues to wear a small Caron brooch that belonged to her mother.

person:manfred-dondarrion.appearance: A lean, broad-shouldered knight with dark hair, a narrow face, and cool grey eyes. His clothing and armour are well maintained but without unnecessary ornament.

person:pearse-caron.appearance: A lean, handsome man with dark brown hair beginning to grey, expressive brown eyes, and a carefully maintained beard. His clothes, horses, weapons, and instruments are always of excellent quality, even when Nightsong's accounts suggest greater restraint.

person:rosamund-caron.appearance: A composed woman with dark chestnut hair, brown-grey eyes, and a graceful bearing. She dresses carefully in Caron colours but often wears small pieces of Swann jewellery.

person:harlan-caron.appearance: A tall, strongly built man with dark hair streaked with grey and a weathered, severe face. He wears the plain black of the Night's Watch and no longer bears Caron arms.

person:morton-caron.appearance: A compact, broad-shouldered man with dark hair, a close-trimmed beard, and watchful brown eyes. He dresses plainly and keeps his possessions arranged with almost excessive care.

person:armond-caron.appearance: A tall, slender boy with dark brown hair, brown eyes, and a deliberate, overly formal bearing. He wears Caron colours whenever permitted and takes unusual care over the condition of his clothes and equipment.

person:ellyn-caron.appearance: A dark-haired girl with brown-grey eyes, a narrow face, and an alert expression. She enjoys bright ribbons, songs, and jewellery and complains when dressed more plainly than visiting children.

person:rolph-wagstaff.appearance: Lean and stooped by an old shoulder wound, with close-cropped grey hair, a hawk nose and a spotted scalp. He wears plain green wool with the yellow mascles at his breast.

person:olwen-wagstaff.appearance: Broad and brisk, with greying brown hair under a plain cap and her sleeves always pushed to the elbow.

person:edric-wagstaff.appearance: Broad, sandy-haired and freckled, with large hands, patient grey eyes and hound hair on his sleeve.

person:aymer-gower.appearance: Stout and balding, with Maris's blue eyes, a neat brown beard, and clothes that are good and a season out of date.

person:hester-gower.appearance: Small and upright, with white hair in a net, Maris's chin, widow's grey, and a ring of keys at her belt.

person:isolde-gower.appearance: Tall and fair, with an elaborate coiffure and jewellery that looks borrowed from a grander house.

person:rickard-gower.appearance: Broad, fair and round-faced, quick to flush, with his father's build coming early.

person:wilmar-hertson.appearance: Slim and fair, handsome in a worn way, with Lynesse's soft brown hair going thin and garments mended with great skill.

person:marian-hertson.appearance: Tall and thin, with white hair under an old-fashioned veil and Lynesse's hazel eyes.

person:dermot-hertson.appearance: Bluff and sandy-haired, with an imitation of Alester's laugh that is a little too loud.

person:cafferen-unnamed-lord.appearance: Middling height and round-shouldered, with thinning fawn-brown hair and anxious brown eyes.

person:cafferen-unnamed-lady.appearance: Thin and neat, with fawn-brown hair under a plain coif and a mouth that tightens at the sight of waste.

person:merrit-cafferen.appearance: Wiry and brown-haired with his father's anxious eyes in a harder face, always dressed one degree better than the occasion needs.

person:alysanne-cafferen.appearance: Small, with fawn-brown hair in a long braid and large, watchful eyes.

person:peasebury-unnamed-lord.appearance: Big-bellied and ruddy, with bright small eyes, a wide laugh and a coat that has been let out twice.

person:hilda-peasebury.appearance: Stout and brisk, with hennaed hair and heavy rings that she turns when she is working out a match.

person:garrett-peasebury.appearance: Tall, loose-limbed and sunburnt, with a battered hat and a scar he shows to strangers.

person:hobart-elmridge.appearance: Thickset and red-faced, with grey bristle and hands permanently stained by the mill.

person:edith-elmridge.appearance: Pale and thin, in layered shawls, with sharp grey eyes that miss nothing in the room.

person:dudley-bushy.appearance: Tall and florid, with a huge moustache and a loud, rolling voice.

person:joan-bushy.appearance: Small and sharp-featured, with grey-streaked black hair and spotless sleeves.

person:margery-graves.appearance: Gaunt and upright, with iron-grey hair, a hooked nose and riding gloves she rarely removes.

person:hal-graves.appearance: Tall and fair, with his mother's hooked nose in a gentler face and a falcon glove on his arm.

person:armond-caswell.appearance: Big and grizzled, with a red nose, a white moustache and a scar along one forearm that he shows to anyone who will look.

person:brenna-caswell.appearance: Slight and brisk, with sandy hair already streaked with grey and a fixed polite smile.

person:joffrey-caswell.appearance: Thin and pale, with sandy hair, Armond's red nose beginning to show, and expensive clothes worn carelessly.

person:cleyton-caswell.appearance: Pretty, fair-haired and slender, with an elaborate cloak and a sword that has never left its scabbard in anger.

person:ashford-unnamed-lord.appearance: Large and bald with a round red face (published description from The Hedge Knight). Other details are unspecified.

person:gwin-ashford.appearance: Short, yellow-haired and round pink-faced (published description at age thirteen in The Hedge Knight).

person:merryweather-unnamed-lord.appearance: Round-faced and ruddy, with a bulbous nose, thinning orange-red hair and a laugh he produces on cue.

person:odessa-merryweather.appearance: Slim and upright, with auburn hair dressed high, a long neck and gowns a season ahead of the neighbourhood.

person:lymond-merryweather.appearance: Slender, auburn-haired and quick-smiling, in clothes that cost more than he can name.

person:alyn-merryweather.appearance: Handsome, unruly chestnut hair, green eyes, a wide mouth, slightly rumpled clothes.

person:gormon-peake.appearance: Tall, broad and handsome, with sandy hair, a scar across one brow and armour better made than his roof.

person:elinor-peake.appearance: Thin and dark, with a worried brow and rings that she twists when he is speaking.

person:edmund-peake.appearance: Slighter than his father, with his mother's dark hair and a neat, careful beard.

person:gyles-peake.appearance: Sandy-haired and fine-boned; wears costly orange-and-black clothing, with polished boots.

person:denys-tarly.appearance: Thick short brown hair, solid tall build, dark green coat with House Tarly's red huntsman.

person:will-risley.appearance: Narrow face, dark hair, dry manner; usually wears a worn green doublet.

person:hugh-redwyne.appearance: Bright restless eyes; costly purple clothing with embroidered grape clusters.

person:meriel-vyrwel.appearance: Brown hair bound behind her head with a ribbon; at the Chapter 54 revel she wore a dark blue gown with a silver-worked girdle.

person:mara-manwoody.appearance: Tall, dark chestnut-haired, with olive skin, observant brown eyes and a composed bearing.

person:nymor-qorgyle.appearance: Dark brown skin, thick black hair, expressive dark eyes, handsome angular features and a lean, athletic build. He favours the lighter, more colourful clothing of his Sandstone upbringing.

person:wendell-webber.appearance: Short and bald, with a goiter on his neck, and troubled by wind (published).

person:harys-oakheart.appearance: Thin as a lath, and holds himself as stiff as a poker (Chapter 62).

person:wyman-webber.appearance: Heavy, florid and wheezing, rings sunk into fat fingers.

person:rohanne-webber.appearance: Small, with a long red braid and a freckled face (published). Sharp-chinned and thin-lipped under the freckles, with eyes that put a price on everyone.

person:lucas-inchfield.appearance: Gaunt and long-jawed, a head above most men and never letting them forget it.

person:eustace-osgrey.appearance: Stooped and grey, in a threadbare surcoat of his house’s faded colours.

person:alysanne-osgrey.appearance: Pale, thin and plain, with downcast eyes and bitten nails.

person:alyn-cockshaw.appearance: Plump and pale, with curly hair the colour of dark honey, and perfumed (published). His curls are oiled and his perfume reaches a room before he does.

person:martyn-vyrwel.appearance: Thin, pallid and stooped, with restless, clever fingers.

person:brienne-vyrwel.appearance: Pinched and pale, always in grey, with a voice like a sigh.

person:allard-costayne.appearance: Paunchy and prematurely grey, weak-chinned behind a fussy little beard.

person:jeyne-costayne.appearance: Tall, bony and sallow, with a long neck and a sour mouth.

person:tommen-costayne.appearance: Big, slow and heavy-browed, with a plodding walk.

person:argrave-defiant.appearance: Long, lantern-jawed and balding, in a peacock’s surcoat.

person:buford-bulwer.appearance: Fat and soft, and blind in his right eye; he wears blood-red armour and a helm with black bull’s horns (published). Huge, sagging and purple-faced, he wears the horned helm like a crown.

person:walder-risley.appearance: Soft, balding and nervous, forever dabbing his upper lip.

person:eden-risley.appearance: Lanky, pockmarked and sharp-elbowed, with lank hair.

person:aubrey-ambrose.appearance: Wiry and grizzled, with a sneer that never quite leaves.

person:willem-wylde.appearance: Square, heavy-jawed and greying, with a face that never relaxes.

person:corwin-rogers.appearance: Thin, dark and hawk-faced, with a crooked smile that never reaches his eyes.
